messages:
Priya: Quick sync: shipping ORBIT routing changes next week. Goal: reduce tail latency for short prompts and keep cost neutral. Proposed approach: phased regional slices, a small A/B for behavior, explicit per-tenant opt-in/hold, and a 4-step rollback ladder. Comments?
Omar: Nice. Can we list the concrete stop conditions? I want exact numbers for runbooks.
Priya: Suggested gates: infra gate = 0.8% 5xx over sliding 10m, perf gate = p99 increase > 750ms vs baseline for 3 consecutive windows, quality gate = automated eval fail rate > 4% on sentinel set, cost gate = token spend > 2.5x projected for 15m. Any one trips -> ladder engages.
Casey: Ladder proposal: 1) auto-downgrade to `orbit-proto-lite`, 2) pin traffic to stable routing, 3) global feature-flag off, 4) region failover to compat cluster. Need exact flag names and owners.
Jin: Flag names: `ff/orbit-routing:variants=[stable,proto,proto-lite]` and control flags `ff/orbit/hold/<tenant>` for holds. Owners: Omar (infra), Casey (runtime), Priya (product).
Laura: Sales asks: pilot tenant onboarding + blackout awareness. We need POST /tenants/{id}/rollout-optin and a bulk CSV import option for holds. Also confirm SSO access for customer success.
Omar: I'll wire a small webhook. ETA 4h for a prototype: POST /api/v1/tenants/{id}/optin body {"opt_in":true}. I'll also add a bulk PATCH endpoint for holds.
QA-Bot: Test plan: shadow-sample 250 prompts, run every 4m; regression alert if >3.5% fail vs baseline. Will post failing prompts to #eng-runtime.
Priya: Staging rollout timeline sketch:
- Preflight (48h smoke + long-tail fuzzing)
- Stage A (us-east micro-canary): 1% -> 5% -> 15% over 90m, manual approval at 5%
- Stage B (eu-west shadow + us-east ramp to 60%)
- Stage C (apac micro-canary): 5% -> 25%
- Stage D (global ramp to 100%)
Each stage has infra + quality + cost gates. Manual approval required at midpoints.
Casey: A/B: run 3% proto and 2% proto-lite for 48h, keep 1% control. Primary metric owners: Casey (quality regression), Omar (infra/p99), Priya (customer delta).
Jin: Router auto-evict rule (example):
```yaml
auto_evict:
  error_rate_threshold: 0.8
  p99_latency_ms: 750
  evaluation_window_mins: 5
  consecutive_failures: 2
  action: downgrade->pin->flag-off
```
This plugs into the traffic router and triggers safe downgrade.
OpsBot: Deploy job queued: canary job `orbit-routing-canary` scheduled in us-east with 1% for 45m. CI link: https://ci.internal/redwood/ORBIT-202
Laura: Cutover window preference: Fri 03:00-07:00 UTC to align with customer availability. Need to confirm with top-10 accounts' blackout lists.
Priya: Agreed. We'll aim for Fri 03:00-07:00 UTC. Customer ops: Marco, please confirm holds.
Casey: SLA clause during warm window: if a Sev1 appears related to ORBIT, rollback within 10m and postmortem owner assigned within 24h. Add an exec notify channel.
Jin: Emergency polyfill idea: if generator call fails or times out > 1.2s, return a short canned fallback with reason code and trace id, and increment degraded-metric. Template: `{"msg":"Sorry, response delayed. Try again in a moment.","trace_id":"<id>"}`. UI prefers this to spinner timeouts.
Priya: Good. Add `polyfill/short-v1` to router responses. Ops add runbook link.
Omar: Metric dashboards needed: routing traffic by variant, p50/p95/p99 latencies, 5xx by region, token burn vs baseline, evaluator fail rate. I'll create a Grafana board and link.
QA-Bot: Preflight tests scheduled: smoke suite + randomized long-tail by tenant for 24h. Will annotate failing tenants for holds.
Casey: Kill-switch policy suggestion: `kill/ff/orbit-routing` requires two approvers from Oncall and Product lead OR one exec + Oncall. Ops must log approver IDs. No single-person kills in prod.
OpsBot: Policy stored. Approval workflow enforced. Audit log will be attached to rollout PR.
Priya: One negotiation point: SRE prefers starting with `proto-lite` only (smaller code-path), we can shadow `proto` and collect evals. Product will accept if SRE signs off by EOD.
Laura: Also ask: can we expose a per-tenant latency SLA opt-in for premium customers to always route to dedicated path? Sales wants this as an upsell.
Omar: We have route tags for premium. Implementation: `ff/tenant/<id>/route=dedicated` and a bypass in the router. Will add to the pilot API.
Priya: Next steps: 1) decide scope (proto-lite only vs proto+proto-lite) by EOD, 2) Omar to open pilot endpoint PR, 3) Jin to finalize auto-evict rules in router, 4) Casey to prepare evaluator sentinel set and dashboard panels, 5) QA-Bot to kick preflight tests. I'll open the shiproom agenda now. :rocket:
